Polished warm storybook digital painting matching the approved Art Direction V2 game boards: tactile softly brushed surfaces, gentle sunlight, dimensional illustrated objects, clean local colour separation and rich small discoveries. No flat vector art, no photographic collage, no generic geometric filler. View/perspective: gently elevated three-quarter view; same gentle light from upper left. Palette dominant soft violet (#AE92C6) with natural object colours. Render exactly five independent painted foreground details on TRUE transparent alpha in a strict3-column by2-row grid, aspect3:2, target2400x1600. Each cell800x800, at least96pxtransparent gutter on every side; no overlap between cells. Bottom-right sixth cell MUST remain completely transparent. No labels, numbers, frames, sky backdrop or contact shadow. Paint only the requested detail for each cell; do not bake rectangular scenery around it. cell(1,1): a long pale water reflection; cell(2,1): a second rippling water reflection; cell(3,1): a reed cluster; cell(1,2): a water-lily leaf; cell(2,2): a small soft cloud. These details are actual parts of the completed painting, not generic decorative particles. Design each isolated silhouette to fit the placement and perspective of this exact scene.
Refine exact five full small silhouettes: first cell a narrow horizontal cluster of warm pale-peach broken pond reflection strokes; second cell a DIFFERENT broader cool pale-lavender reflection ripple, thinner broken strokes; third cell a short green reed cluster with two slender brown seedheads, complete tapered base; fourth cell one olive-green water-lily leaf with notch, floating flat on water, shallow ellipse seen three-quarter from slightly above, warm highlights and no shadow rectangle; fifth cell one tiny blue-green dragonfly with four translucent delicate wings, hovering diagonally (replaces provisional cloud, appropriate to pond). Genuine transparent alpha outside each silhouette and BETWEEN reflection strokes. No water, sky, ground, shadows, haze, glow or rectangular surroundings. Invisible 3x2 placement only, leave huge empty gutters, all five silhouettes comfortably inset, sixth cell absolutely empty. Match actual softly painted lavender pond at warm sunset, no flat clipart.
